data.narrative:
Loft Orbital is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $326M to date. Valuation analysis relies on a peer set of 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Apex Space at $2.3B, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.6B, and others), complemented by 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 27.4x price-to-sales.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage advancement to the $326M capital raised, implying $554M. Peer-median analysis across the 6 same-sector comps yields $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.1B (minimum) to $8.0B (maximum, anchored by Sierra Space). Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which private companies rarely provide.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $471M (low), $1.2B (median), and $2.1B (high). The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in peer comparability—particularly the outsized valuation of Sierra Space relative to the cohort median. Key risk factors include stage-to-stage progression assumptions and whether Loft Orbital's business model and market position align more closely with near-median peers or sector outliers.
